descriptionChirho: Spatial or social location in the middle of a group, place, or territory, consistently rendered with Arabic wasaṭ (وَسَط), Korean gaunde (가운데), and Swahili katikati/miongoni.

The interior of a person or entity understood as the seat of thoughts, emotions, and volition, consistently rendered with Arabic dākhil (داخِل), qalb (قَلْب), or bāṭin (باطِن), Korean sok (속) or an (안), and Swahili ndani or moyo.
The literal internal organs of an animal, especially in sacrificial and dietary contexts, consistently rendered with Arabic aḥshāʾ (أَحْشَاء), Korean naejang (내장), and Swahili matumbo.
